review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: • Collaborate closely with data scientists, BI analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • 5+ years of experience in data engineering with a strong focus on Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Fabric). • Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark / Spark SQL) for large-scale data transformation. • Proficiency in at least one programming language: Python (preferred), Scala, or C#/.NET. • Excellent spoken and written English • Communication, organizational and analytical skills Preferred Qualifications: • Experience with real-time or near-real-time streaming pipelines (Azure Event Hubs, Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming). • Hands-on experience with CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
